text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of a long and
arduous
journey in the Twinkle Series for
me and my
trainee. Her name is...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm Aston Machan. It's nice to meet you,
and I'm eager to take my first steps
toward being
everyone's ultimate
favorite mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
From this second on, your eyes are
mine—so don't
ever look away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No matter how close or far I seem, the
little cameras in your head will zoom and
focus until I'm
crystal clear in your heart.
Okay? Don't forget.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begin my days challenging the
Twinkle
Series with
<chrname>!
